description: Build all page-level routes: Destinations (list all, filter by Dzongkhag, detail pages), Tours/Packages (grid with tier filters), Vehicles (categorized grid), Hotels (star-rating filter), Food (menu-style listing), and Experiences (categorized with filters). Each page should display items with their prices and relevant details from the data layer.
steps: Create src/app/destinations/page.tsx - Main destinations page showing all 20 Dzongkhags as cards in a grid. Each card shows Dzongkhag name, brief description, number of places. Include a search/filter bar to filter by name.

Create src/app/destinations/[id]/page.tsx - Dzongkhag detail page showing: Dzongkhag name, full description, facts list, and a grid of places worth visiting. Each place shows name, description, why to visit, and entry fee if applicable.

Create src/app/tours/page.tsx - Tours/Packages page with a tier toggle (Premium/Luxury/All). Display tours as detailed cards showing: name, tier badge, category, duration, price per person, highlights preview. Add category filter (Honeymoon, Anniversary, Cultural, Adventure, Festival).
Create src/app/tours/[id]/page.tsx - Tour detail page showing full itinerary (day-by-day), all inclusions, highlights, pricing breakdown, and a CTA to customize or book.

Create src/app/vehicles/page.tsx - Vehicle selection page with category tabs (Luxury SUV, Electric, Bus, Sedan, Premium). Display each vehicle as a card with name, capacity, price per day, features list.

Create src/app/hotels/page.tsx - Hotels page with star-rating filter tabs (3-star, 4-star, 5-star, All). Show hotel cards with name, location, star rating visualization, price range, amenities preview. Clicking expands to show room types and prices.
Create src/app/food/page.tsx - Food experiences page showing all dining options as menu-style cards. Each shows name, description, price per person, menu items, duration, dietary info.

Create src/app/experiences/page.tsx - Experiences page with category filter tabs (Cultural, Romantic, Adventure, Wellness, All). Display experience cards with name, category badge, price, duration, location, description.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 page routes render without errors
Destinations page lists Dzongkhags and detail pages show places with prices
Tours page shows packages filtered by tier and category with pricing
Vehicles page shows categorized transport options with daily rates
Hotels page shows star-filtered hotels with nightly prices
Food page shows dining experiences with per-person pricing
Experiences page shows categorized activities with pricing
npm run build succeeds with all pages
verification: Run npm run build in /projects/sandbox/Brainstrom and confirm all pages compile without errors
